issues.description: Pipeline snapshots again flatten their internal socket inputs without preserving which component produced each value. When a snapshot taken on the second or later visit of a component is resumed, those restored values are therefore reconstructed as external inputs instead of predecessor-produced inputs, changing component-readiness semantics and allowing the pipeline to report all components blocked. The old resume path also keeps treating the breakpoint component as a resumed component on later loop visits instead of consuming that special handling once, which can bypass normal input consumption. Snapshot resume must preserve the internal sender/value topology and apply resume-only handling only to the paused execution.
issues.repair_unit: persist and restore internal pipeline inputs with sender provenance and scope special resume handling to the paused execution only
issues.mechanism_pattern: snapshot serialization flattens socket inputs and resume reconstructs them as external values while repeatedly reusing resume-only input handling
issues.invariant_pattern: snapshot resume must preserve the pipeline's internal sender/value topology and later loop visits must return to normal input consumption
